item.tib: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa
item.coloph: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa slob dpon dbyig nyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harma shrI b+ha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
